title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Report Extension Examples & Use Cases
summary: This blog series covers multiple articles on extending and customizing reports in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including report extension objects, adding media and comments, PDF password protection, modifying sorting and filters, and managing report layouts and exports.
key_points: Report extensibility via ReportExtension object allows adding columns and fields to standard reports
Reports can be customized with media, comments, notes, signatures, and regional settings
PDF password protection and custom filenames for exports can be configured without control add-ins
Report layouts and request pages can be modified to change sorting, filters, and disable print/preview options
Custom columns added via extension may not appear in exported layouts from the Report Layouts page

quotes.text: Custom columns/fields added via Report Extension not found in standard layouts exported from Report Layouts page
quotes.why_it_matters: Developers need to understand that extension-added fields behave differently in exported layouts, affecting customization strategies
